page.layout: One column of running text, set in italic. No page number, running head or signature printed. "Occur-" stands at the right of the last line as the catchword.

main_text.p: aut rationibus meis aut existimationi magis aduersarium. Retundit haec assiduè generosiores quosque animi impetus: eximium quid aufuri conatus frangit: memoriam pessimè labefactat: sermonis vim aut praeripit, aut sistit: vt, quod mihi visus sum quandoque mente concepisse haud prorsus incommodè aut abs re, hoc aut non aufim proloqui statuà tacitur-nior; aut si tentè, sic timidè, sic gelidè, sic id faciam haesitans, vt aliquanto nonnunquam praestaret non tentasse. Dicam verbo, & quod resest[?]; una haec timiditas, & (si dabitis vocabulo veniam) haec infiducia mei, vt de munere hoc detrectando serio cogitarim, atque etiam aliud eam in rem tentarim; plus effecit, quàm cætera illa, quantumvis gravia, quae hactenus commemini, universa.

page.notes: Catchword "Occur-" is at the right below the last line. Doubtful readings: "resest[?]" (the word before "una" is hard to read, probably "resestuna" or a similar form for "resest" with a hyphen or semicolon). The page starts mid-sentence, so the first paragraph continues from the previous page. Italic type is used throughout. Long s is transcribed as plain s.
